text:
Updated `review.json` (`verdict: "needs_changes"`, 3 findings across the files involved in the nested `InfoCard` defect):

### Findings
1. **`plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.tsx` (line 148, blocker)**: `UnreadNotificationsCard` wraps its body in `<InfoCard title={title} className={className}>`; when passed as `Content` to `HomePageWidgetBlueprint`, `CardExtension` wraps it in a second `<InfoCard>`. Extract and export `UnreadNotificationsCardContent` without an outer `InfoCard` and have `UnreadNotificationsCard` wrap `UnreadNotificationsCardContent` in `<InfoCard>`.
2. **`plugins/notifications/src/alpha.tsx` (line 58, blocker)**: `unreadNotificationsCard` sets `Content: m.UnreadNotificationsCard` in `HomePageWidgetBlueprint.make`. Change `components` to pass `Content: m.UnreadNotificationsCardContent` so `CardExtension` renders the single outer `InfoCard`.
3. **`plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx` (line 485, major)**: Add `expect(screen.getAllByText('Unread notifications')).toHaveLength(1)` in the `HomePageWidgetBlueprint` extension test to verify no duplicate nested card header is rendered.

### Passing checks
- **`plugins/home-react/src/extensions.tsx` & `extensions.test.tsx`**: `Progress` imported directly from `@backstage/core-components`; `CardExtension` tested without `AppContext`.
- **`NotificationsPage.tsx`, `NotificationsTable.tsx`, `NotificationsTable.module.css`, `NotificationsPage.test.tsx`**: `?id=` deep-link highlighting implemented with active `--bui-*` tokens and covered by unit test.
- **`translation.ts` & `alpha.tsx` strings**: `notificationsTranslationRef` defines `unreadNotificationsCard.*` messages; `HomePageWidgetBlueprintParams` requires string `title`/`description` matching `change_plan.md` U11.
- **`useRouteRef` fallback in `UnreadNotificationsCard.tsx`**: Unconditional hook call with safe fallback to `'/notifications'` when `rootRouteRef` is unmounted, matching `change_plan.md` U09 rule 7.
- **Manifests, API reports, docs, and changesets**: Additive-only `package.json` changes, up-to-date `report-alpha.api.md`, and clean `README.md`, `docs/notifications/usage.md`, and `.changeset/*.md` with no internal symbol names.
